Class Car

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.BaseEntity
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.first.spring.model.Car
@Entity public class Car extends BaseEntity
Represents a car entity in the dealership. This class is used both as JPA entity and JAXB XML element.
